# Content display

Figma: `Content display`, node `368:13923` (page Components, `1:28`).
4 variants - `property 1[2]` x `property 2[2]`.

A 32px avatar or glyph beside a title and subtitle.

## Markup

```html
<div class="v27-content-display">
  <span class="v27-content-display__media">
    <img src="/people/jane.jpg" alt="" />
  </span>
  <div class="v27-content-display__text">
    <span class="v27-content-display__title">Avatar default</span>
    <span class="v27-content-display__subtitle">Sub text</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

With a glyph, put an `<svg>` in the same slot.

## Classes

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.v27-content-display` | the row |
| `.v27-content-display__media` | 32px avatar or glyph |
| `.v27-content-display__text` | the text column |
| `.v27-content-display__title` | Base, `Foreground/Primary` |
| `.v27-content-display__subtitle` | Sm, `Foreground/Secondary` |

## Values

Verified on `368:13922` (Avatar) and `368:13920` (Icon) - identical but for the slot's
contents.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| gap | `--v27-spacing-s` (8px) |
| media | 32px (`--v27-size-l`) |
| title | Base - Outfit 16 / 400 / 20 |
| subtitle | Sm - Outfit 14 / 400 / 16 |
| title/subtitle gap | **none** |

## It is two shapes, not four

Figma's `property 2` axis reads `Default` and `Default with text`, but **both rows render a
title and a subtitle** - the measured nodes are the same shape. The set listing also shows
the axis values duplicated. See FINDINGS.md #27.

## Compare with Header display

[Header display](HeaderDisplay.md) is nearly the same component: a leading slot, a title
and a subtitle, 8px apart. Two things differ, and both are real:

| | Content display | Header display |
|---|---|---|
| title | Base (16 / 400) | Lg bold (18 / 600) |
| title/subtitle gap | none | 2px |

They are close enough to be confused. Use Header display to head a page or panel, and
Content display for a row inside one.

## All classes in this component

`.v27-content-display`, `.v27-content-display__media`, `.v27-content-display__subtitle`, `.v27-content-display__text`, `.v27-content-display__title`
